item.title: Kansas House responds to complaints, unveils bill revamping Board of Nursing’s authority
item.description: Three people recounted traumatic nursing regulatory experiences in Kansas House testimony supporting a bill written to force administrative changes at the Kansas State Board of Nursing and void some of the board's disciplinary actions. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence school board to hear report on Native American Student Services; no public comment planned
item.description: The Lawrence school board on Monday will hear an annual report on Native American Student Services. Also, for the fourth meeting in a row, there will be no general public comment. Continue reading ...

item.title: Patrons invited to preserve, relive memories in Lawrence Public Library digitization lab
item.description: Tucked next to the local history room in the library’s basement, patrons can find a DIY Memory Lab dedicated to digitizing older media formats from MiniDV camcorder tapes to Super 8mm film to shellac 78 rpm records. Continue reading ...

item.title: Trans Kansans and allies use Statehouse restrooms in act of ‘malicious compliance’
item.description: For many trans Kansans and allied activists, Friday's "pee-in" wasn’t their first time in the state Capitol building in Topeka. Years of commitment to the cause led to the day’s event. Continue reading ...

item.title: Valentine’s Day events around Lawrence for kids, adults and everyone in between
item.description: From a romance-themed night of Slavic fortunetelling to sugar cookie decorating for kids, here's a list of heart-fluttering events happening around Lawrence for Valentine's Day and the week leading up to it. Continue reading ...

item.title: A new strategy in Olathe builds whole neighborhoods of homes that stay affordable for years
item.description: Habitat for Humanity of Kansas City is using community land trusts to build entire neighborhoods that aim to help address the state’s affordable housing shortage. Continue reading ...

item.title: Waldorf-inspired high school to open this August in Lawrence, starting with one class
item.description: A new Waldorf-inspired high school will open in August, starting with one class of freshmen that will be taught at the Lawrence Arts Center. Continue reading ...
